relations.title: Orden parcial de dimensiones no fungibles
Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
relations.reading: Attribution measures should preserve their separate dimensions; improvement in one coordinate does not automatically compensate for an unmeasured or worsening coordinate elsewhere.

relations.title: Entropy, Capability Activation and Sociotechnical Engineering
relations.reading: An activation can improve output while worsening coordination burden; without a justified conversion rule, that is a trade-off rather than an unqualified improvement.

relations.title: From Endured Dependence to Chosen Solidarity
relations.reading: Chosen solidarity can include an explicitly accepted trade-off; an analyst should not erase that choice by collapsing nonfungible dimensions into a universal score.

relations.title: Dos maneras de cruzar un mundo Arquitecturas que empobrecen vs arquitecturas que multiplican
relations.reading: A generative-integration assessment can preserve nonfungible gains and losses, leaving trade-offs or unknown dimensions explicit instead of declaring a universal net improvement.
